title: Bloor local growth largely exceeds the change in the three-road count index
classification: Descriptive before/after, same calendar month; corridor-average count index
comparison: June2016 versusJune2017, before/after lateAugust2016 treatment; three consecutive weekdays per corridor.

metrics.unit: sum of three corridor-average daily counts; not an audited common screenline or unique journeys
sum of three corridor-average daily counts; not an audited common screenline or unique journeys

boundary_warning: The sum averages multiple video sites separately on each corridor. It is NOT an audited common screenline, unique riders, unique journeys or total people. Dupont/Harbord may receive displaced traffic, so are outcomes rather than untreated controls.
uncertainty: Only three waves, rain on some final countdays, no occupancy/subway/bus loads or independent untreated comparison. Local49% includesBay;56% excludesBay; dry-dayalmost70% is a different subset.

title: Bloor peak-direction driving takes longer after lane conversion
classification: Observed road driving time, not complete journey or person-minutes
comparison: GPS runs June2016 versusJune2017, Bay Street to Ossington Avenue.
uncertainty: No passenger weights, bicycle/transit journey times or door-to-door coverage. Signal timing changes are part of observed package. Times on parallel routes vary differently; see full CSV.
